description_md:
## Earn Bitcoin at AliExpress

AliExpress is the global marketplace for low-cost electronics and just about everything else. Buy through Satsback and you get up to 2.7% of your order value back in Bitcoin, paid as sats to a Lightning wallet you control.

If AliExpress is already on your shopping list, routing the order through Satsback is free money on spending you'd do regardless — this page covers the current rate, how the tracking really works, and whether it's worth the extra step for a marketplaces purchase.
how_it_works_md:
## How AliExpress Bitcoin cashback works

1. Create a free Satsback account (no KYC required) and add the browser extension.
2. Open AliExpress through Satsback — the extension prompts you to activate rewards with one click.
3. Shop and check out as normal. Your cashback (up to 2.7%) shows as *pending* in your Satsback dashboard.
4. After AliExpress confirms the sale, the sats become withdrawable to any Bitcoin Lightning wallet.

**Tracking caveat — worth reading.** Satsback depends on affiliate tracking, and users report roughly two out of three orders track cleanly (it sits around 3.2/5 on the Chrome Web Store). To give yourself the best odds: disable ad-blockers on the AliExpress tab, don't run other coupon or cashback extensions at checkout, and make the Satsback tab the last thing you touch before paying. If an order doesn't appear within a few days, Satsback support can chase it with your receipt.
worth_it_md:

The rate is solid for marketplaces; on a normal-sized AliExpress order it adds up to a worthwhile chunk of sats.

Two things to weigh: the reward is Bitcoin, so its fiat value moves with BTC — a plus if you're stacking long-term, a variable if you're not. And Satsback rarely stacks with AliExpress's own loyalty program on the same order, so compare the two and use whichever pays more.

faqs.answer_md: No. Satsback is free and requires no KYC — you only need an account and the browser extension to earn Bitcoin at AliExpress.

name: Foot Locker
description_md:
## Earn Bitcoin at Foot Locker

Foot Locker, the sneaker and athletic-footwear retailer Foot Locker, is one of the stores paying Bitcoin back through Satsback. Buy through Satsback and you get up to 2.5% of your order value back in Bitcoin, paid as sats to a Lightning wallet you control.

Rather than a coupon or cashback voucher, Foot Locker shoppers get paid in Bitcoin here. Below: the live rate, the honest truth about tracking reliability, and when it's actually worth using for fashion.
how_it_works_md:
## How Foot Locker Bitcoin cashback works

1. Create a free Satsback account (no KYC required) and add the browser extension.
2. Open Foot Locker through Satsback — the extension prompts you to activate rewards with one click.
3. Shop and check out as normal. Your cashback (up to 2.5%) shows as *pending* in your Satsback dashboard.
4. After Foot Locker confirms the sale, the sats become withdrawable to any Bitcoin Lightning wallet.

**Tracking caveat — worth reading.** Satsback depends on affiliate tracking, and users report roughly two out of three orders track cleanly (it sits around 3.2/5 on the Chrome Web Store). To give yourself the best odds: disable ad-blockers on the Foot Locker tab, don't run other coupon or cashback extensions at checkout, and make the Satsback tab the last thing you touch before paying. If an order doesn't appear within a few days, Satsback support can chase it with your receipt.
worth_it_md:
## Is it worth it?

The rate is solid for fashion; on a normal-sized Foot Locker order it adds up to a worthwhile chunk of sats.

Two things to weigh: the reward is Bitcoin, so its fiat value moves with BTC — a plus if you're stacking long-term, a variable if you're not. And Satsback rarely stacks with Foot Locker's own loyalty program on the same order, so compare the two and use whichever pays more.

faqs.question: How much Bitcoin do I earn at Foot Locker?
faqs.answer_md: Currently up to 2.5%, credited in sats to your Satsback dashboard once Foot Locker confirms the order.

faqs.question: Do I need to verify my identity (KYC) to earn?
faqs.answer_md: No. Satsback is free and requires no KYC — you only need an account and the browser extension to earn Bitcoin at Foot Locker.

faqs.question: When can I withdraw my Foot Locker cashback?
faqs.answer_md: Once the order moves from *pending* to *confirmed* (after Foot Locker's return window closes), your sats are withdrawable to any Bitcoin Lightning wallet.

Komt een bestelling na een paar dagen niet binnen, dan kan Satsback-support hem met je bonnetje natrekken.
worth_it_nl_md:
## Is het de moeite waard?

Het tarief is prima voor online; op een normale bestelling bij DreamLand telt het al snel op tot een leuk bedrag aan sats.

Omdat de beloning in Bitcoin wordt uitbetaald, spaar je bij elke aankoop een beetje sats — precies waarom veel mensen sats-back verkiezen boven gewone cashback. De waarde beweegt wel mee met de koers van Bitcoin.

faqs_nl.question: Hoeveel Bitcoin verdien ik bij DreamLand?
faqs_nl.answer_md: Op dit moment tot 1,6%, als sats bijgeschreven in je Satsback-dashboard zodra DreamLand de bestelling bevestigt.

faqs_nl.question: Moet ik me verifiëren (KYC) om te verdienen?
faqs_nl.answer_md: Nee. Satsback is gratis en vraagt geen KYC — je hebt alleen een account en de browser-extensie nodig om Bitcoin te verdienen bij DreamLand.

faqs_nl.question: Wanneer kan ik mijn DreamLand-cashback opnemen?
faqs_nl.answer_md: Zodra de bestelling van *in behandeling* naar *bevestigd* gaat (na de retourtermijn van DreamLand), kun je je sats opnemen naar elke Bitcoin Lightning-wallet.
